source.title: World Rubik's Cube Championship 2011 on October 14-16, 2011 in Bangkok, Thailand
source.content:
The [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2011](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2011) will take place on October 14-16, 2011 in Bangkok, Thailand. Check out the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2011 website](http://www.thailandcube.com/wc2011) for more information and registration.  
  
  
 [Live video streaming](http://worldrubik2011.voicetv.co.th/) from Friday to Sunday.  
 [semi live results](http://live.cubing.net/WC2011/#0).

translation.title: 2011 年世界魔方锦标赛将于 10 月 14–16 日在泰国曼谷举行
translation.content:
[2011 年世界魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2011)将于 2011 年 10 月 14–16 日在泰国曼谷举行。更多信息及报名请见[赛事网站](http://www.thailandcube.com/wc2011)。

周五至周日提供[视频直播](http://worldrubik2011.voicetv.co.th/)。

[准实时成绩](http://live.cubing.net/WC2011/#0)。
